reason: B better addresses high-contact-stress service, extends prior DCT and MAO/LST findings through a testable combined treatment, and includes single-treatment controls plus explicit wear, hardness, and fatigue criteria. Its main weakness is that LST is described after MAO even though the cited adhesion mechanism supports texturing before MAO, but A is less suitable because its porous stress-buffer mechanism is weakly supported and its testing is limited to moderate wear rather than the stated extreme-service limitation.
